R538.note: supports() narrowed to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken.class.isAssignableFrom, the correct Spring Security shape; authenticate() and the token contract untouched.

R539.note: Containment now requires BASE_DIR exactly or BASE_DIR + File.separator prefix on the canonical path, closing the /app/uploads-evil sibling bypass with no other behaviour change.

R540.note: strncat bounded to remaining-1 closes the overflow, but filenames over 105 bytes are now silently truncated and the function returns 0 with a wrong display path (out is 256 so the claimed out_size rejection never fires); truncation is stated but its effect is misdescribed.

R541.note: Column and direction allowlists (the restriction the contract calls for) with stated created_at DESC fallback; accountId stays parameterized and the intended sort keys remain available.

R542.note: Plaintext listener now serves only an https redirect and the app is reachable solely through protectedHandler, matching the stated intent; redirect built from r.Host is the standard idiom (would carry :8080 through if a client hits that port directly, but that is deployment mapping, not a break).

R543.note: GET to POST puts the delete behind CsrfFilter correctly, but the existing 'delete my account' link callers now get 405; the write-up states this as a required client follow-up, so 1 not 0 (stale GetMapping import left behind, harmless).

R544.note: mode != NULL short-circuit before strcmp; strict still enables, other values disable, unset returns 0 as the contract requires.

R545.note: CommandType.StoredProcedure with @customerId bound as NVarChar; same procedure, same result set, customerId can no longer be SQL syntax.

R546.note: playerIndex >= MAX_PLAYERS check before the write, out-of-range packets discarded; unsigned compare covers every bad index and valid slots unchanged.

R548.note: Build FAIL: invents DatabaseHelper.getConnection() which does not exist, so the PreparedStatement fix never compiles; the assumption and the changed SQL string passed to outputUpdateComplete are stated openly, hence 1 rather than 0.

R549.note: @EnableMethodSecurity on SecurityConfig activates the existing @PreAuthorize(hasRole('ADMIN')) interceptors; non-admins now get AccessDeniedException, which is the fix, and admin callers are unaffected.

R550.note: execFile('whois', ['--', domain]) removes the shell and the -- marker (honoured by GNU and BSD whois getopt) also closes flag injection; same stdout/error handling as before.

R551.note: Client Content-Type replaced by Tika magic-byte detection against image/png and image/jpeg; genuine PNG/JPEG still store and return the filename, spoofed types fail before store(), and the new Apache Tika dependency is stated.

R547.note: Route moved to DELETE and wrapped in CrossOriginProtection closes the CSRF vector, but the email-notification link the original served (a plain GET) now fails; the method change is stated though its effect on that link is not called out.
